title: 第二千六百六十四章 林容的努力第二千六百六十三章 蔚蓝水波的反应与操作
content_zh:
就在玩家们争相涌入海外之地，拉开大航海时代的序幕之际，艾洛西亚等重生者也没有闲着。
前文曾提过，主大陆的整体形状，就好比一个三角尺，中空部位是迷海，被十四个帝国疆域（含蛮夷势力）围绕。
以围绕迷海的帝国疆域算作第一环，主大陆的帝国疆域（含蛮夷势力以及罗斯荒域等地区）由内向外可分成五环。
即便算上围绕在主大陆附近的东荒古陆（原日天帝国疆域）、双子大陆（原圣不列颠帝国疆域）和萨洛兰大陆等外围领土也不过六环。
每一个帝国疆域的实际面积在二至三亿平方公里左右，只是长宽和形状不甚相同而已。
整体来说，每一个帝国疆域的长宽，不管是东西向还是南北向，最长不会超过两万五千公里，最短也不会少于一万公里，一般多在一万五千至两万公里的区间。
主大陆的近海、远海、外海，再加上海外之地的边界，每一片海域的宽度均为五千公里，加总起来也就相当于隔着一个帝国疆域。
换言之，主大陆的近海、远海、外海，乃至于海外之地边界的面积总和，约为五十五个帝国疆域。
以横跨一个帝国疆域两万公里计算，在海外之地边界绕一圈，差不多需要航行一百一十万公里。
以新型赛特兰●古代方舟每小时一百公里的航速，二十四小时不停地航行，也需要一年零三个多月才能跑完整个航程，就更不用说是一般的风帆战船了。
可林容这个苦命娃，硬是凭借海上洋流每日四五千公里的航速，花了大半年时间跑完四分之三的航程，并将沿途的暴风圈秘地纳入方舟组织的掌控。
是的，海上洋流。
在艾洛西亚等人重生以前，玩家们也曾在暴风圈秘地栽过不少跟头，但也因此发现了海外之地边界的海上洋流。
不知道是海外之地边界的环境使然，还是暴风圈秘地本身的特性所致，又或二者兼有之，海外之地边界存在一条顺时针环绕的海上洋流。
正常来说，海上洋流不会出现大角度的拐弯，可在海外之地边界遇到这个情况，海上洋流的拐角处必有暴风圈秘地存在。
玩家们在发现这一点以后，便学会在不小心闯入暴风圈秘地的虹吸范围时，尽可能地顺着水流的方向，在其外围海域航行，寻找并利用海上洋流来自救。
正因如此，林容才能这么轻易地找到暴风圈秘地的位置，并在这么短的时间里面就在海外之地边界绕了大半圈。
除此之外，林容还通过猎杀沿途遭遇的海王类生物，将自身的等级提升到二转一百三十八级，距离三转晋阶c级层次也只剩下最后一小段路。
值得一提的是，以鲲灵碎片为核心所搭建起来的传送网络，不仅将这些暴风圈秘地串联在一起，还藉由巫源道的巫源通天界作为跳板，直接通联主大陆和海外之地。
只不过，艾洛西亚等人现阶段所能掌控的，只有暴风圈秘地这一块。

暴风圈秘地最大的价值，不在于岛上通联巫源道和无尽炼狱的传送通道，而在于岛外的暴风圈。
这一层暴风圈并不单单只有物理隔绝的能力，连同一般的传送手段也会被一并隔绝，只有像巫源道和无尽炼狱与之相连的跨位面传送通道，以及利用鲲灵碎片这种特殊的珍稀资源所搭建起来的传送网络，才能无视暴风圈的隔绝能力。
也正因为艾洛西亚等人了解这一点，才会试图将暴风圈秘地打造成暗阁组织乃至于方舟组织的对外据点。
可正所谓：成也萧何，败也萧何。
content_en:
While players are rushing to flock to overseas lands and kick off the Age of Discovery, Aelosia and other reborns are not idle either.
As mentioned before, the overall shape of the main continent is like a triangular ruler, with the hollow part being the Lost Sea, surrounded by fourteen imperial territories (including barbarian forces).
The imperial territory surrounding the Lost Sea is counted as the first ring. The imperial territory of the main continent (including barbarian forces and areas such as the Ross Wasteland) can be divided into five rings from the inside to the outside.
Even if you include the outer territories such as the Eastern Wilderness Ancient Continent (formerly the territory of the Sun and Sky Empire), the Twin Continents (the former territory of the Saint Britain Empire) and the Saloran Continent surrounding the main continent, they are only six rings.
The actual area of ​​each empire's territory is about 200 to 300 million square kilometers, but the length, width and shape are very different.
Generally speaking, the length and width of each empire's territory, whether it is east-west or north-south, will not exceed 25,000 kilometers at its longest, and will not be less than 10,000 kilometers at its shortest, and generally range from 15,000 to 20,000 kilometers.
The offshore, distant seas, and outer seas of the main continent, plus the boundaries of overseas lands, each have a width of 5,000 kilometers, which in total is equivalent to the territory of an empire.
In other words, the total area of ​​the main continent's offshore, distant seas, outer seas, and even the boundaries of overseas lands is approximately fifty-five imperial territories.
Based on the calculation of 20,000 kilometers across the territory of an empire, it would take approximately 1.1 million kilometers to sail around the borders of overseas lands.
At the speed of the new Setlan Ancient Ark, which is one hundred kilometers per hour, and it sails non-stop for 24 hours, it will take more than a year and three months to complete the entire voyage, let alone an ordinary sailing warship.
But Lin Rong, a poor child, just relied on the sea currents to travel at a speed of four to five thousand kilometers per day, and spent more than half a year to complete three-quarters of the voyage, and brought the secret areas of the storm circle along the way under the control of the Ark organization.
Yes, ocean currents.
Before Aelosia and others were reborn, the players had made many mistakes in the secret land of the Storm Circle, but they also discovered the ocean currents at the border of the overseas land.
I don't know if it is due to the environment at the border of the Overseas Land, or due to the characteristics of the secret land of the storm circle itself, or a combination of both. There is a clockwise ocean current at the border of the Overseas Land.
Normally, ocean currents do not turn at large angles, but when encountering this situation at the borders of overseas lands, there must be a secret storm circle at the corner of the ocean currents.
After players discovered this, they learned to follow the direction of the current as much as possible and sail in its outer waters when they accidentally broke into the siphon range of the secret land of the storm circle, looking for and using ocean currents to save themselves.
Because of this, Lin Rong was able to find the location of the secret land of the Storm Circle so easily and circled most of the border of the overseas land in such a short period of time.
In addition, Lin Rong also raised his level to Level 2, 138 by hunting down the Neptune-like creatures he encountered along the way. He was only a short distance away from being promoted to Level C at Level 3.
It is worth mentioning that the transmission network built with Kunling fragments as the core not only connects these storm circle secret places together, but also uses Wuyuan Dao's Wuyuan Tongtian Realm as a springboard to directly connect the main continent and overseas places.
However, what Aelosia and others can control at this stage is only the secret land of the Storm Circle.
The greatest value of the secret land of the Storm Circle lies not in the transmission channel connecting the Wuyuan Dao and the Endless Purgatory on the island, but in the Storm Circle outside the island.
This level of storm circle not only has the ability to physically isolate, but also general means of transportation. Only the cross-dimensional teleportation channels connected to it, such as Wuyuan Dao and Endless Purgatory, and the transmission network built using special rare resources such as Kunling fragments, can ignore the isolation ability of the storm circle.
RightBecause Aelosia and others understood this, they tried to build the secret land of the Storm Circle into an external stronghold for the Dark Pavilion Organization and even the Ark Organization.
But as the saying goes: Xiao He is also a success, and Xiao He is a failure.
